nitrogenBasis.label: Total nitrogen
nitrogenBasis.otherBasis: Protein, amino nitrogen, g/100 mL or another basis

products.label: Tomato ketchup and tomato sauce
products.identity: This standard covers tomato ketchup and sauce prepared from tomato juice, purée or paste.
products.change: The 2018 amendment lowered the minimum acidity from 1.0% to 0.2% as acetic acid.

products.label: Soybean sauce
products.identity: This standard covers sauce made by fermenting soybean paste after complete inactivation of trypsin inhibitors.
products.change: The 2021 replacement lowered the salt-free soluble-solids minimum from 25.0% to 15.0% and added a 1.0% total-nitrogen minimum by mass.
